title: Holy grail
summary: Header, three columns, footer, and a phone layout that stacks.
brief: At 800px: header and footer span the full width; between them, a 160px nav on the left, a 160px aside on the right and main filling the middle.
At 375px every section stacks in source order.
hints: This is one grid with three rows and three columns.
grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr 160px, and grid-template-areas to draw the layout. Give each section a grid-area.
For 375px, a media query that sets a single column and an areas list with one name per row.
solutionNotes: Named areas draw the layout as a picture, and each section picks its spot with grid-area. The media query redraws the picture as one column; the HTML never changes.
